analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its highest-ever half-yearly financial performance in H1 FY27, with revenue from operations growing 23% YoY to ₹1,235 crore and PAT surging 96% YoY to ₹125 crore. Profitability was temporarily boosted by favorable Nutrient-Based Subsidy (NBS) rate revisions, though management expects normalized EBITDA margins of around 13% in the second half of the fiscal year. Demand during the upcoming Rabi season is anticipated to remain supportive due to enhanced subsidy allocations and higher Minimum Support Prices for key crops. Management remains confident in meeting its full-year performance targets while evaluating expansion opportunities across industrial chemicals and new geographies. Krishana Phoschem Limited reported its highest ever half-yearly performance in H1 FY27, with revenue from operations reaching ₹1,235 crore and PAT surging 96% YoY to ₹125 crore.

guidance.claim: Management believes achieving the annual turnover target should not be very difficult based on its track record and network.
guidance.quote: However, considering our track record, marketing capabilities, sales team, and network of wholesalers and traders, we believe achieving the target should not be very difficult.

guidance.claim: The company expects its second half turnover to improve compared to the first half.
guidance.quote: Our second half turnover will be better.

guidance.claim: Management expects to maintain an EBITDA margin of around 13% in the second half of the year.
guidance.quote: We expect to maintain an EBITDA margin of around 13% in the second half.

guidance.claim: Management expects long-term EBITDA margins to remain in the range of 12% to 13%.
guidance.quote: However, if you look at a longer period, say over three-year intervals, you will find that we have broadly been able to maintain EBITDA margins of around 12%–13%.

demand_outlook.claim: Uneven monsoon distribution and cautious dealer restocking influenced NPK demand in Q2 FY27.
demand_outlook.quote: The domestic fertilizer industry navigated a mixed operating environment during Q2 FY27 with uneven monsoon distribution, cautious dealer restocking and changing crop nutrition preferences influencing NPK demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Strong government subsidy support is encouraging farmers to shift towards balanced NPK grades for the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: Improving affordability, backed by strong government subsidy support, is now prompting farmers to shift towards balanced NPK Grades during Rabi season to restore soil health.

demand_outlook.claim: Management expects fertilizer demand during the Rabi season to continue along similar lines and achieve targeted volumes.
demand_outlook.quote: We expect demand during the Rabi season to continue along similar lines.

demand_outlook.claim: SSP production and sales saw a moderate decline across the industry while NPK complex fertilizers experienced a sharper contraction.
demand_outlook.quote: Consequently, SSP production and sales saw a moderate decline across the industry while NPK complex fertilizers experienced a sharper contraction.

demand_outlook.claim: Price gaps during the Kharif season led farmers to heavily favor DAP and urea.
demand_outlook.quote: During the Kharif season, price gaps led farmers to heavily favor DAP and urea resulting in imbalanced soil nutrient profiles.

demand_outlook.claim: Overseas suppliers serve approximately 35% to 40% of the complex fertilizer market in India.
demand_outlook.quote: Around 35%–40% of the market is still served by overseas suppliers.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has not planned any capacity expansion in the Single Super Phosphate (SSP) segment.
capex_expansion.quote: No, we have not planned any capacity expansion in the SSP segment so far.

capex_expansion.claim: The capacity expansion for NPK and DAP has already been implemented by the company.
capex_expansion.quote: The NPK/DAP capacity expansion has already been implemented.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is actively evaluating expansion opportunities in industrial chemicals and new geographies to diversify growth.
capex_expansion.quote: Simultaneously, we are actively evaluating expansion opportunities across industrial chemicals and new geographies to diversify our growth engines.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is evaluating certain projects and plans to present a final proposal once evaluation is complete.
capex_expansion.quote: The management is currently evaluating certain projects, and we will present a final proposal at the appropriate time once the evaluation is complete.

margins_costs.claim: Q2 FY27 EBITDA margin improved to 18% compared to 12% in Q2 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA: Surged 74% YoY to ₹127 crore, with EBITDA margin improving to 18% from 12% in Q2 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: The normal operating EBITDA margin range for the company is 12% to 13%.
margins_costs.quote: Otherwise, our normal EBITDA margin would be in the range of 12%–13%.

margins_costs.claim: Phosphoric acid and sulfur prices remained high globally, while ammonia prices softened slightly and rock phosphate remained stable.
margins_costs.quote: Regarding international raw material prices, phosphoric acid and sulfur remained elevated while ammonia prices softened slightly and rock phosphate stayed broadly stable.

margins_costs.claim: The government introduced special support equal to 20% of actual procurement costs for domestic sulfur and sulfuric acid manufacturers.
margins_costs.quote: The government introduced special support equivalent to 20% of actual procurement costs for domestic sulfur and sulfuric acid manufacturers, subject to floor prices.

margins_costs.claim: The increase in H1 EBITDA was primarily driven by NBS policy rates announced by the Government of India.
margins_costs.quote: This is primarily due to the Nutrient-Based Subsidy (NBS) rates announced by the Government of India and made applicable during the period.

margins_costs.claim: The company reduces its own production of sulphuric acid when competitive by-product material is available from other manufacturers.
margins_costs.quote: If such by-product material is available at a more competitive price, we reduce our own production.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY27 EBITDA grew 56% year-on-year to ₹216 crore, while profit after tax reached an all-time high of ₹125 crore.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 56% year-on-year to ₹216 crore, while profit after tax reached an all-time high of ₹125 crore, growing 96% year-on-year, reflecting disciplined execution, operational efficiency and resilient business fundamentals.

margins_costs.claim: Raw material costs showed mixed trends with elevated sulphur and phosphoric acid prices, slightly softened ammonia prices, and stable rock phosphate prices.
margins_costs.quote: Input cost trends remained mixed during the period, with sulphur and phosphoric acid prices elevated, while ammonia prices softened slightly and rock phosphate prices remained broadly stable.

orders_capacity.claim: Fertilizer production reached 1,81,906 metric tonnes and sales stood at 1,70,783 metric tonnes in H1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Volumes: Fertiliser production stood at 1,81,906 metric tonnes, with sales of 1,70,783 metric tonnes.

orders_capacity.claim: The company aims to maintain NPK and DAP capacity utilization in the range of 70% to 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK/DAP, depending on market conditions, demand, sulphuric acid prices and other factors, we will try to maintain a reasonable capacity utilisation level, which may be in the range of 70%–80%.

orders_capacity.claim: The addition of new product variants allowed the company to maintain SSP capacity utilization above 100%.
orders_capacity.quote: In the last year, we introduced not only SSP but also three additional products. This is one of the reasons we have been able to maintain SSP capacity utilisation above 100%.

orders_capacity.claim: The SSP segment is operating at more than 100% capacity utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: Regarding capacity utilisation, we are operating the SSP segment at more than 100%.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has achieved peak capacity utilization in SSP while maintaining significant headroom to scale manufactured NPK business.
orders_capacity.quote: With peak capacity utilisation in SSP and significant headroom to scale our manufactured NPK business, we are well-positioned to enhance production volumes, improve integration benefits and strengthen our market presence.

capital_allocation.claim: Substantial imports during the latter part of the half-year led to an increase in short-term borrowings.
capital_allocation.quote: Particularly during the latter part of the half year, we undertook substantial imports, which led to an increase in borrowings.

capital_allocation.claim: The company recorded an all-time high current assets level of ₹1,700 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Gentlemen, not only reserve. Our current assets level is also Rs. 1,700 crore. All time high.

capital_allocation.claim: The company maintains strong operating margins and an efficient working capital cycle.
capital_allocation.quote: Strong operating margins & efficient working capital cycle

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues in West Asia and transit uncertainties in the Strait of Hormuz increased freight and insurance costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: At the same time, geopolitical tensions in West Asia and transit uncertainties around the Strait of Hormuz disrupted international trade flows, driving up freight and insurance costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Price differences led farmers to heavily prefer DAP and urea during the Kharif season, resulting in soil nutrient imbalances.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the Kharif season, price gaps led farmers to heavily favor DAP and urea resulting in imbalanced soil nutrient profiles.

risks_headwinds.claim: Increases in NPK prices created pressure on pushing products into the market.
risks_headwinds.quote: With the increase in NPK prices, we have also faced some pressure in pushing our products into the market.

risks_headwinds.claim: Uneven rainfall in agricultural regions affected Kharif sowing and moderated fertilizer consumption.
risks_headwinds.quote: Uneven rainfall in the agricultural regions affected Kharif sowing and moderated fertilizer consumption, particularly in the phosphatic and potassic segments.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions continue to create uncertainty across global commodity markets.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions continue to create uncertainty in global commodity markets.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects second half turnover to be better than the first half.
management_commitments.quote: Our second half turnover will be better.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects to maintain an EBITDA margin of around 13% in the second half of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We expect to maintain an EBITDA margin of around 13% in the second half.

management_commitments.claim: The company will maintain 100% capacity utilisation in the SSP segment for the full year.
Green ammonia supplies under the agreement with SECI are expected to commence from April 2029.
management_commitments.quote: Supplies expected to commence from April 2029.
